title: The Essence Well
text: A well brims with something that is not water, cold and bright and very still, lighting the faces that lean over it from below. It hums in your fingertips when you reach toward it. Bottled, it is worth a fortune. Drunk, it is worth more.

options.label: Bottle what you can, and leave the drinking to braver fools.

outcomes.text: You fill every flask you have, cold, bright and humming. The well is no lower for it.

options.label: The bravest drinks from the well, unable to resist what it might give.

outcomes.text: For a day they glow faintly from the inside. Nobody likes to look at them.
It burns going down, a cold fire that keeps burning long after.

options.label: Mark it for the House and post a sign, so that every rival knows whose it is.

outcomes.text: The sign is posted. Any rival who finds it will know whose well this is.
